messages:
Jules (support): Customer AcmeCorp opened a ticket — they started getting 429s from the enforcer ~2026-02-10 03:41 UTC but Console shows zero usage for the token. Ticket #C-4921. sample req id: req_0a7f9c. Screenshot (redacted): https://redwood.app/console/snap/abcd
Ava (support): Which env/token? Any recent deploys?
Jules (support): Prod, token tok_acme_01. Rate plan standard-100k. There was a streaming-ingest rollout ~03:30 UTC last night. Customer says every request returns 429 with body: {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429}.
Ken (enforcer): I can see deny events for tok_acme_01 at 03:41 in enforcer logs (rate check -> deny). Oddly the ingestion consumer that powers Console counters shows zero messages for that token. Suspect mapping key change or partition routing issue.
Riya (eng-monitoring): Checking metrics now — kafka topic rate-metrics overall lag = low, but partition 12 has ~7k backlog. The dashboard aggregator reads topic->partition mapping by token hash. If hashing changed during the rollout some tokens could be landing in a partition that the consumer group isn’t reading.
Ken (enforcer): Reproduced locally:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer tok_acme_01" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"quota_exceeded","details":"meter:request_tokens"}
```
Jules (support): Customer shared timeline — calls started failing immediately after deploy and kept failing even though Console stayed at 0. They need a quick mitigation.
Sam (product): Customer is P1. Can we temporarily bypass enforcement for that token until we resolve the telemetry gap? They need traffic unblocked.
Ken (enforcer): We can whitelist tok_acme_01 on the enforcer for a short window. Requesting ops approval and a short ticket to track rollback.
CI-Bot: action:rollback requested by @Ken — streaming-ingest:release-2026-02-10-03:37 -> release-2026-02-09-22:11. Status: initiated.
Riya (eng-monitoring): After rollback, consumer partition assignments rebalanced and backlog drained. Partition 12 consumers caught up; ingestion counts for tok_acme_01 start appearing around 03:58 UTC.
Jules (support): Customer tested after rollback — requests now 200. They confirmed traffic resumed. Marking incident mitigated for now.
Ken (enforcer): Root cause hypothesis: rollout changed token->partition hashing (config tweak). Enforcer and Console relied on different mapping versions during the window, so enforcer enforced correctly but Console missed ingest records. Need postmortem and a coordinated deploy for hashing changes.
Sam (product): Please record timeline, API keys affected, and action items. We should add a safety check preventing hash config changes without consumer reassign.
Jules (support): Logged notes in ticket #C-4921 and asked customer to confirm full recovery. Leaving thread open until postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
